_comment: Cross-language contract for the Sync device enrollment proof. All values are fictional. Go asserts this in control_plane_test.go; Rust asserts it in src-tauri/src/sync/identity.rs. Both compare against this file rather than against each other, so a change on either side shows up as a failure here instead of as a signature that silently stops verifying. This fixture exists because the two sides had already drifted: Rust concatenated bytes while Go marshalled JSON, and Go's payload carried a createdAt the server stamped on arrival, so no client could produce a proof that verified.
